title: root_dio_signature.py derives DODAGID via rejected native profile; corpus root_signature.json encodes it
description: Found during kd0p review. python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py calls native_address_from_pubkey (SHA-512 native profile, ipv6/addr.py:192) for the RPL root signature DODAGID; test/vectors/root_signature.json was generated under that derivation (generator oracle text says 'DODAGID from the same vectors'). Post upstream-yggdrasil-addressing the DODAGID MUST be upstream AddrForKey(root_pubkey). Same fix shape as kd0p's capability_announcements regen: flip derivation to ipv6.addr.upstream_addr_for_key (added in 6d9528888f), regenerate root_signature.json, update consumers. NOTE r1ur warned root_authorization.json is another last consumer of the native _addr_for_key in test_protocol_vector_security.py — coordinate so the two flips land consistently; do NOT let one corpus go upstream while a shared consumer still expects native.
close_reason: FIXED (driver-swept commits b3626a253c+c572af2cc6 + my a3cb027582). DODAGID binding migrated from rejected SHA-512 native profile to upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey across the full consumer surface: (1) rpl/root_signature.py verify_dodagid_binding + verify_root_signature + derive_dodagid_from_pubkey + generate_root_signature_vector; (2) crypto/root_dio_signature.py verify step 3; (3) corpora regenerated: root_signature.json (8 vectors field-flipped, 2 intentional-mismatch kept and asserted still-unbound under upstream), root_authorization.json (generate.py builder flip), root_dio_signature.json (generator gained anchored upstream helper — regenerated valid_basic wire is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the already-upstream Rust fixture in root_sig.rs and C fixture comment 020030ad..., a 3-way independent convergence), authenticated_schc_dio.json (root dodag 0202d5e2368077b55775c4a91be4b124 byte-identical to r1ur's independently-documented value — merge with r1ur's branch will be trivial); (4) consumer tests flipped: test_protocol_vector_security.py (new _upstream_addr_for_key helper, 3 check sites, dead native _addr_for_key removed, test renamed native->upstream), rpl/test_root_signature.py + crypto/test_root_dio_signature.py fixtures. ORACLE: all AddrForKey implementations anchored to pinned yggdrasil_address.json upstream vector + differential-validated (2005 cases this round, 0 mismatches; reviewer independently ran 2259 cases, 0 mismatches). TESTS: full python suite 12713 passed (only known up5p edhoc flake family red, evidence commented there); cargo -p lichen-node root_sig 24/24 green in isolated target dir. CODEREVIEW: opencode-run delegation attempted 3x this round (all timed out mid-review after substantive partial work) — passes completed manually per fallback: correctness (differential oracles + byte-exact cross-impl convergence + dead-code sweep), security (binding compare semantics preserved, negatives stay negative, stale-profile acceptance closed), edge (anchor aborts before corpus write, degenerate keys match Go wrap/discard, lazy imports cycle-free, docstring drift fixed). FINDINGS FILED: qr3c (lichen-rpl address_assignment pre-existing red test, same family, not caused by this change), + follow-up bead for rpl_messages.json native DODAGID pin (residual consumer, deliberately out of scope: multi-impl corpus needs Rust/C consumer audit first).
